description: This file defines the class 'ImmutableSubject', an immutable implementation of the 'Subject' interface, including methods for creation, JSON serialization, and equality checks.

classes.name: ImmutableSubject
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Subject interface, representing a subject with an ID and type, with factory methods and JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Subject with the given subjectId and default SubjectType.GENERATED.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Subject with the specified subjectId and subjectType.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Subject instance from a JSON object and issuer+ID string, extracting type information from JSON.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the SubjectId of this Subject.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the SubjectType of this Subject.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this Subject into a JsonObject, considering schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on subjectId and subjectType.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on subjectId and subjectType.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Subject object.
